directional_constructor_provenance.unchanged_standard_accuracy: Retain historical ordinary S endpoints; new S runs only for the prespecified controlled timing subset.
directional_constructor_provenance.unit_roundoff: numpy float64 eps/2; node separation threshold32u; dimensionless p_hat storage
directional_constructor_provenance.guarded_trials: Reject invalid optimizer trial with +inf and zero gradient before assembling any column or fitting; the last accepted feasible state is retained.
directional_constructor_provenance.timing: All workers single BLAS/Torch thread. Accuracy concurrency is labeled and not interpreted as controlled timing. Controlled subset uses one worker and exclusive campaign reservation.

runtime_policy: Accuracy campaigns may run concurrently. Controlled timing repetitions run serially without other task computation. Single numerical thread. All failures retained. Fixed benchmark subset selected before reruns.
scope_note: Historical S and all linear1d endpoints remain historical; accuracy runtimes are excluded from runtime comparisons. Controlled NC/C benchmark samples are separate from full accuracy cohorts. Directional controlled runs alone use the separately hashed restart-safe-v1 derived wrapper; their states, coefficients, events, fits, iterations, joins, completions, errors, guard counts and stop status must exactly match the frozen accuracy records. Independent accuracy/timing uses the original frozen guarded source. Variance and supplemental 2D controls are separate cohorts.
